name: chart-table
description: XY chart of a table. This is how MassFlow results are read: 'massflow record' writes extracted mass per period into a table, 'massflow drawpoint dump-drawperiod' writes a draw schedule into one, and 'massflow marker size-distribution' writes the cumulative fragment-size curve into one.
notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against MassFlow 3D 9.

keywords.description: Show or hide the item without removing it.
keywords.name: active

keywords.description: Table to plot, by name or number.
keywords.name: table

keywords.description: Configure the x axis (label, log, limits, exponent).
keywords.name: axis-x

keywords.description: Configure the y axis (label, log, limits, exponent).
keywords.name: axis-y

keywords.description: Draw a glyph at each data point.
keywords.name: marks

keywords.description: Swap the x and y series.
keywords.name: swap

keywords.description: Set item transparency (0 opaque .. 100 fully transparent).
keywords.name: transparency

examples.command: plot item create chart-table table 'all DPs'
examples.description: Plot the table written by `massflow record name 'all DPs'`. Use case: Extracted mass by period

examples.command: plot item create chart-table table 'size-distribution' axis-x log on
examples.description: Plot the cumulative percent-passing curve written by `massflow marker size-distribution`, with a log size axis. Use case: Fragment size distribution
